protocol_decisions.architecture: DirectPANAligner raw-intensity dualstem GN4/GN8 with common LN ResBlock64, FC64->32->2 total dy/dx zero-init. No prior/prewarp/matching/checkpoint donor.
protocol_decisions.augmentation: Preserve prior always-Hflip/always-Vflip and uniform rot90 for the same PAN/MS/LMS/GT tensors; epsilon sampled afterward from independent stream.
protocol_decisions.diagnostics: Fixed train4/val4/RR2/FR2, radii.25/.5/1/2/3, no diagnostics optimizer updates; initial layer gradients at1/2/10/100. Time measured locally and reserved within48h.
protocol_decisions.display: Fixed full DN range and recorded RGB channels; visualization-only gains1, no scene-adaptive stretching.
protocol_decisions.geometry: R3 epsilon and native correction use Lanczos4; support radius4 plus R3 fits view_margin8, fixed ROI8/stencil7
protocol_decisions.priority: All valid official same-state candidates ranked HQNR descending then ERGAS ascending; no target-gap override. SCC still printed/measured.
protocol_decisions.qb-rre: RGB-mean reference Stage1 with all four input/output bands and unified Lanczos4, sensor-specific sources and validation; own historical baseline or new local coefficient branch
protocol_decisions.recipe: Preserve previous explicit W112d123/P0 optimizer, batch, precision and paired augmentation. New prior-free shift, R3 and derived boundary contract require disposable smoke and measured timing before official admission.
protocol_decisions.sheet: PAN_PASSED_STEPS_OR_BEST_HQNR_V1 fixed64; separate thresholds from STRICT_TARGET_ONLY artifacts. Preserve other campaigns.
protocol_decisions.sources: Existing pinned ablr2 sensor sources and provided LMS, unchanged RR/FR scene sets; no reconstructed LMS replacement.
protocol_decisions.timing: Initial artifact/probe300s reserves are explicitly unmeasured conservative placeholders. Disposable preflight and actual calls replace applicable times; p90 and1.2 safety+two confirmations+2hcloseout gate every admission.

pruning.rationale: Conservative explicit operational proposal: no lexicographic target-gap improvement over latest three valid evaluations; no positive tolerance or statistical significance claim.
